<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$labels</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$counters</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$free</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$closed</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$patterned</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$bare</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$nestedMap</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$listMap</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$withProps</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            labels: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'labels'</span>],
            counters: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'counters'</span>],
            free: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'free'</span>],
            closed: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'closed'</span>],
            patterned: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'patterned'</span>],
            bare: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'bare'</span>],
            nestedMap: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'nestedMap'</span>],
            listMap: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'listMap'</span>],
            withProps: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'withProps'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'labels'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;labels,
            <span class="hl-str">'counters'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;counters,
            <span class="hl-str">'free'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;free,
            <span class="hl-str">'closed'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;closed,
            <span class="hl-str">'patterned'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;patterned,
            <span class="hl-str">'bare'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;bare,
            <span class="hl-str">'nestedMap'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;nestedMap,
            <span class="hl-str">'listMap'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;listMap,
            <span class="hl-str">'withProps'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;withProps,
        ];
    }
}
